args.body: generation 4: The lifespan layer exists now. It needs three rates: what kills the fly from the inside, what the design proposes to change that to, and what kills it from the outside. The third is the one the ecology layer bears on -- 29 taxa are on record eating this clade -- and turning a predator list into a hazard is a judgement somebody has to make and state, so the run states it.
